# Written the way a person writes YAML and prettier does not. Every other
# file in this corpus probes what prettier *breaks*; this one probes what
# it *rewrites*. Nothing here is about line width -- each rewrite happens
# at every width.

# Spacing around `:`, which people pad by hand and prettier collapses.
name:    demo
version:  "0.1.0"
enabled:  true

# Padding inside flow brackets, and spacing around the commas.
padded: [ 1 , 2 , 3 ]
tight: [1,2,3]
# Flow mappings are the mirror image: prettier pads the braces out.
compact: {x: 1,y: 2}
half: { x: 1,y: 2 }
# Empty containers exercise the no-named-child gate path.
empty_sequence: [ ]
empty_mapping: { }

# Sequence dashes flush with the key, which YAML allows and prettier indents.
root:
- first
- second
nested:
  list:
  - one
  - two

# A nested sequence written with the dash on its own line; prettier
# collapses it to the compact `- - item` form.
flags:
  - one
  -
    - nested-a
    - nested-b

# Runs of spaces (and a tab) before a trailing comment.
port: 8080          # many spaces before this one
host: localhost	# a tab before this one

# A source trailing comma on a flat flow sequence is dropped.
trailing: [1, 2, 3,]

# Explicit `?` keys; prettier writes the implicit form. Named tree is unchanged.
? explicit
: value



# Three or more blank lines above; prettier caps a run at one.
replicas: 2
